This script uses the MICE package to generate 10 imputed datasets using the random forest multiple imputation by chained equations method. Models can be fitted to these datasets and results combined.

```{r load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(tictoc)

rm(list = ls())
```

1. Load data and assess missingness

```{r load preprocessed ELA data and assess missingness}

ELAdata <-  read.csv("Data/ELAdata_for_MICE.csv")

str(ELAdata)

ELA_var_sums_NA <- as.data.frame(sapply(ELAdata, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))) # check missing data
ELA_var_sums_NA

missingness <- ELA_var_sums_NA %>%
  mutate(perc_missing = sapply(ELAdata, function(x) sum(is.na(x)) / nrow(ELAdata) * 100))

average_missingness <- mean(missingness$perc_missing)
average_missingness
# 1.53%

ELAnona <- na.omit(ELAdata)
perc_missing_cases <- 100 - (nrow(ELAnona)/nrow(ELAdata) * 100)
perc_missing_cases
# 27.96%

```


2. Set up MICE parameters and generate imputed datasets (these are stored in a "mids" type object)

```{r set up imputation}

init = mice(ELAdata, maxit=0) 

meth = init$method
meth[] <- "rf"                    # set imputation method to random forest due to presence of multiple variable types
meth["subjectkey"] <- ""          # remove unnecessary variables from imputation
meth["eventname"] <- ""


predM = init$predictorMatrix
predM[, "subjectkey"] <- 0        # remove unnecessary variables from the predictor matrix
predM[, "eventname"] <- 0 

tic()
set.seed(161)
imputed_data <- mice(ELAdata, method = meth, predictorMatrix = predM, m = 10, maxit = 20)
toc()

summary(imputed_data)
imputed_data$imp$demo_comb_income_v2

ELAdata_complete <- complete(imputed_data, 1) # provides one of the imputed data sets (change number to select another data set)
ELAdata_complete_nona <- na.omit(ELAdata_complete) # should be no missing data

saveRDS(imputed_data, file = "Data/ELAdata_imputed.rds") 
ELAdata_imputed <- readRDS("Data/ELAdata_imputed.rds")

```

3. Evaluate imputation 

```{r compare summary stats}

observed_data <- summary(ELAdata)
observed_data <- as.data.frame(t(observed_data))

imputed_data <- summary(ELAdata_complete)
imputed_data <- as.data.frame(t(imputed_data))


```


```{r plots to evaulate convergence}

plot(ELAdata_imputed)

```
